validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED. The sheet's own citation trail (gem.wiki footnote 4, 'U.S. natural gas pipeline projects', linking to eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php) points to a navigation page, not a citable document -- traced it to the actual dated workbook it summarizes: EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Oct2019.xlsx and _Jan2020.xlsx (Historical Projects tab), which carries a Sanford Project / Florida Gas Trans Co row: Expansion, Completed, in-service 2019-08-01, FL/FL/FL, cost $4.2M, length 0.4 mi, capacity 36 MMcf/d, diameter 20 in, Interstate, FERC docket CP19-58. Independently found and verified a second, different-origin document: Federal Register notice FR Doc. 2019-02345 (publ. 2019-02-14), the public notice for FERC Docket No. CP19-58-000, describing FGT's Jan 29, 2019 prior-notice filing to build lateral looping in Volusia County, FL and back-pressure regulation on the East Leg mainline in Orange County, FL, 'in support of the proposed Sanford Project', raising firm transportation to the FPL Sanford power plant from 15.7 to 17.2 MMMBtu/hr. The two sources agree on existence, timing, location and (via unit conversion, see the Capacity fill) capacity -- this is a real, built, FERC-authorized project, not a GEM-only or hallucinated entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- an interstate natural-gas transmission expansion/lateral under FGT's blanket certificate (NGA section 7), gas commodity confirmed. DUPLICATE CHECK: compared against all 15 'Florida Gas Transmission Pipeline' rows in the 50-row roster (P4028-P4060). The EIA workbook independently carries a distinct row for essentially every one of them, each with its own length/diameter/capacity signature matching a different named FGT project -- P4028=FGT Western Division Project (len 1/dia 8,36/cap 69), P4029=FGT Phase VIII Expansion (len 483/dia 24,30,36,42/cap 820), P4031=FGT East Leg Expansion (len ~7/dia 30/cap 10), P4032=FGT Phase VII Phase 1 (len 17.3/dia 36/cap 95), P4033=FGT Turkey Point Lateral (len 0.3/dia 24/cap 100), P4034=FGT Phase VI Project (len ~33/dia 36/cap 121), P4035=FGT Phase V Stage 4 (len 136/dia 16,24,36/cap 130), P4036=FGT Phase V Stage 3 (len 15/dia 24/cap 180), P4037=FGT Phase V Stages 1-2 (len 64/dia 16,24,36/cap 298), P4038=FGT AE Cooperative Upgrade (len ~0/dia 30,36/cap 80), P4039=FGT Phase IV Project (len 139/dia 30,36/cap 200), P4040=FGT Alabama Power Lateral (len ~1/dia 12/cap 62). One anomaly noted in passing but NOT mine to fix: roster entry P4030 (Capacity=50000.00) does not match its likely EIA counterpart, FGT Jacksonville Expansion Project (len 9/dia 20,30/cap 15) -- a two-orders-of-magnitude capacity mismatch worth a validity check on P4030 itself, flagged via cross_row_leads.
